s0101.literal: Also, because Li's vegetable diet had long continued and was not what a wasting illness could bear, an edict said: "To be able to keep plain cloth is indeed lofty; you are already advanced in years and your strength has somewhat declined—just when I wish to rely on you, I truly need you hale; I now give you fish and meat—you must not stubbornly follow what you have held to.
s0101.idiomatic: Because Li's vegetable diet had long continued and was not what a wasting illness could bear, an edict said: "To keep plain cloth is indeed lofty; you are advanced in years and your strength has declined—just when I wish to rely on you I need you hale; I now give you fish and meat—you must not stubbornly hold to your vow.

s0102.literal: " Li in the end did not follow.
s0102.idiomatic: " Li in the end did not obey.

s0103.literal: In the second year of Tiancheng he died, aged fifty-nine.
s0103.idiomatic: In Tiancheng year 2 (561) he died, aged fifty-nine.

s0104.literal: Emperor Wen grieved deeply, posthumously made him Palace Attendant, posthumous name Dezi.
s0104.idiomatic: Emperor Wen grieved deeply, posthumously made him palace attendant, posthumous name Dezi.

s0105.literal: When the coffin returned to his home district the emperor went out in person to see him off—the age counted it glory.
s0105.idiomatic: When the coffin returned home the emperor went out in person to see him off—the age counted it glory.

s0106.literal: His sons Shiji and Shinan were both known in youth.
s0106.idiomatic: His sons Shiji and Shinan were both known in youth.

s0107.literal: Ji, styled Ci'an, was clever in youth.
s0107.idiomatic: Ji, styled Ci'an, was clever in youth.

s0108.literal: When a few years old, a guest came to visit his father and met Ji at the gate; he therefore mocked him, saying: "Young master, your surname is Yu—you must surely have no wisdom.
s0108.idiomatic: When a few years old a guest came to his father and met Ji at the gate. He mocked him: "Young master, your surname is Yu—you must have no wisdom.

s0109.literal: " Ji answered on the spot: "If you cannot tell the characters, are you not foolish?
s0109.idiomatic: " Ji answered at once: "If you cannot tell the characters, are you not foolish?

s0111.literal: Entering he said to Ji's father: "This child is no ordinary person—Wenju's reply was not better than this."
s0111.idiomatic: Entering, he told Ji's father: "This child is no ordinary person—Wenju's reply was not better."

s0112.literal: When grown he loved learning and was skilled at literary composition.
s0112.idiomatic: Grown, he loved learning and wrote well.

s0113.literal: By nature he was mild and still, with the will to dwell in seclusion.
s0113.idiomatic: By nature he was mild and still and wished to dwell in seclusion.

s0114.literal: At twenty he was recommended as a cultivated talent and in the policy response ranked high.
s0114.idiomatic: At twenty he was recommended as cultivated talent and ranked high in the policy response.

s0115.literal: He began his career as Left Regular Attendant in the Kingdom of Xuan[cheng] under Liang.
s0115.idiomatic: He began as left regular attendant in Liang's Kingdom of Xuancheng.

s0116.literal: In the Datong era, once in a sudden rain, before the hall there were often mixed-colored precious pearls; Emperor Wu of Liang viewed them with great pleasure, and Ji therefore submitted a eulogy on the auspicious rain.
s0116.idiomatic: In the Datong era a sudden rain once left mixed-colored pearls before the hall. Emperor Wu of Liang was greatly pleased, and Ji submitted a eulogy on the auspicious rain.

s0117.literal: The emperor said to Ji's elder brother Li: "This eulogy's style is clear and lofty—your family's Shilong.
s0117.idiomatic: The emperor told Ji's elder brother Li: "This eulogy is clear and lofty—your family's Shilong.

s0118.literal: How will you promote and employ him?
s0118.idiomatic: How will you promote and employ him?

s0119.literal: " When Ji heard it he sighed: "To praise the flourishing virtue's form is only to voice the joy of beating clods.
s0119.idiomatic: " When Ji heard it he sighed: "To praise flourishing virtue is only to voice the joy of beating clods.

s0120.literal: Am I one who buys a name to seek office?
s0120.idiomatic: Am I one who buys a name to seek office?

s0121.literal: " He then shut his door and claimed illness, taking only books for pleasure.
s0121.idiomatic: " He shut his door and claimed illness, taking only books for pleasure.

s0122.literal: When the Prince of Yueyang was Administrator of Kuaiji he brought in Ji as a traveling aide, transferred him to Staff Recorder, and had him lead the commandery's Five Offices Major.
s0122.idiomatic: When the Prince of Yueyang was administrator of Kuaiji he brought Ji in as traveling aide, then staff recorder, leading the commandery's five offices major.

s0123.literal: He was again transferred to Central Staff Recorder, major unchanged.
s0123.idiomatic: He was again made central staff recorder, major unchanged.

s0124.literal: In office he was brief with troublesome detail, keeping to the great body; within the bureau all day was silence.
s0124.idiomatic: In office he was brief with troublesome detail and kept to the great body; within the bureau all day was silence.

s0125.literal: When Baoying allied by marriage with Liu Yi he secretly harbored rebellious designs; Ji faintly knew his intent and in conversation always stated the logic of obedience and rebellion, subtly admonishing; Baoying always turned to other matters to refuse.
s0125.idiomatic: When Baoying allied by marriage with Liu Yi he secretly harbored rebellion; Ji faintly knew it and in talk always stated the logic of obedience and rebellion, subtly admonishing; Baoying always turned to other matters.

s0126.literal: He also once had attendants recite the Book of Han while he lay listening; when it reached Kuai Tong telling Han Xin "I see your back—nobility beyond words," Baoying started up and said "He may be called a wise man."
s0126.idiomatic: He once had attendants recite the Book of Han while he listened lying down. At Kuai Tong telling Han Xin "I see your back—nobility beyond words," Baoying started up: "He may be called wise."

s0127.literal: Ji with stern countenance said: "Overturning Li and insulting Han is not enough to be called wisdom;
s0127.idiomatic: Ji said sternly: "Overturning Li and insulting Han is not enough to be called wisdom;

s0128.literal: how does it compare with Ban Biao's Mandate of Kings, knowing where to turn?"
s0128.idiomatic: how does it compare with Ban Biao's Mandate of Kings, knowing where to turn?"

s0129.literal: Ji knew Baoying could not be admonished and feared disaster reaching himself; he therefore wore lay believer's robes to refuse him.
s0129.idiomatic: Ji knew Baoying could not be admonished and feared disaster; he wore lay believer's robes to refuse him.

s0130.literal: He constantly dwelt at East Mountain Temple, falsely claiming foot ailment and not rising again; Baoying thought it pretense and had Ji's sleeping house burned; Ji lay at ease and did not move.
s0130.idiomatic: He dwelt at East Mountain Temple, falsely claiming foot ailment and not rising; Baoying thought it pretense and burned Ji's sleeping house; Ji lay still.

s0131.literal: Close kin were about to help Ji out; Ji said: "My fate has something it hangs on—where would fleeing go?
s0131.idiomatic: Kin were about to help him out; Ji said: "My fate has something it hangs on—where would fleeing go?

s0132.literal: " Those who had set the fire at once themselves put it out.
s0132.idiomatic: " Those who set the fire at once put it out themselves.

s0134.literal: When Liu Yi raised troops Baoying supplied his command; Ji therefore by letter admonished to the utmost, saying:
s0134.idiomatic: When Liu Yi raised troops Baoying supplied his command; Ji therefore wrote a letter admonishing to the utmost:

s0135.literal: Yu Ji of East Mountain sends a letter to the Bright General, Lord and Envoy: Ji, adrift through worldly change, sojourns in your honored district; the general treated him with the rites of a chief guest and extended the affection due a state's scholar—the feeling stirred, what day could it be forgotten!
s0135.idiomatic: Yu Ji of East Mountain to the Bright General, Lord and Envoy: Adrift through worldly change, I sojourn in your honored district. You treated me with a chief guest's rites and a state's scholar's affection—what day could that feeling be forgotten!

s0136.literal: Yet Ji's deep illness lingers on, the setting sun nearly spent; I constantly fear I may suddenly fill a ditch and moat and repay not even a drop of dust—therefore I dare lay bare my inmost heart and risk stating my loyal red; I wish the general would pause a moment's thought and reflect a little—then on the day eyes close, what is in the breast would be complete.
s0136.idiomatic: Yet my deep illness lingers, the setting sun nearly spent; I constantly fear I may fill a ditch and repay not even a drop—therefore I dare lay bare my heart and risk my loyal red. Pause a moment's thought and reflect a little—then on the day my eyes close, what is in my breast would be complete.

s0137.literal: The omens of safety and danger, the mechanisms of fortune and calamity, are not only Heaven's seasons, Editorial footnote marker 7. but also lie in human affairs.
s0137.idiomatic: The omens of safety and danger, the mechanisms of fortune and calamity, are not only Heaven's seasons, [7] but also lie in human affairs.

s0138.literal: To miss by a hair's breadth is to err by a thousand li.
s0138.idiomatic: Miss by a hair's breadth and err by a thousand li.

s0139.literal: Therefore the wise man holds heavy position without toppling, grasps great integrity without losing it—how would he be deluded by floating words?
s0139.idiomatic: Therefore the wise hold heavy position without toppling, grasp great integrity without losing it—how would they be deluded by floating words?

s0140.literal: The general combines civil and martial gifts, his heroic prestige unmatched in the age; in former days through many hardships you took sword and raised troops, lifted the banner and swore the host, resisted prestige a thousand li—was it not because the four suburbs had many ramparts and together you plotted for the royal house, set the age right and repaid the lord, settled the state and sheltered the people?
s0140.idiomatic: You combine civil and martial gifts, heroic prestige unmatched in the age; in former days through hardship you took sword and raised troops, lifted the banner and swore the host, resisted prestige a thousand li—was it not because the four suburbs had many ramparts, you plotted for the royal house, set the age right, repaid the lord, settled the state and sheltered the people?

s0141.literal: This is why boys five feet tall all wished to carry halberds and follow the general.
s0141.idiomatic: This is why boys five feet tall all wished to carry halberds and follow you.

s0142.literal: When the Founder Martial Emperor first laid foundation in the grass and darkness and first crossed hardship.
s0142.idiomatic: When the Founder Martial Emperor first laid foundation in grass and darkness and first crossed hardship,

s0143.literal: Editorial footnote marker 8. At that time the realm boiled, the people had no fixed lord, wolves and jackals blocked the road, whales and krakens struck across, within the seas all were fearful and did not know whom to follow.
s0143.idiomatic: [8] the realm boiled, the people had no fixed lord, wolves blocked the road, whales struck across, within the seas all were fearful and did not know whom to follow.

s0144.literal: The general moved with the discernment of minute signs, broke the persuasions of vertical and horizontal alliance, registered his name and entrusted his person, trusting himself to the clan alliance—this is the general's subtle reckoning and far design, issuing from sincere heart.
s0144.idiomatic: You moved with discernment of minute signs, broke vertical-and-horizontal persuasions, registered your name and entrusted your person to the clan alliance—this is subtle reckoning and far design from a sincere heart.

s0145.literal: When the Son of Heaven succeeded the enterprise, he was reverent, bright, and sage, chose the worthy and employed the able, ministers were harmonious; he bound the general with the weight of a wall city and honored the general with enfeoffment splitting the soil.
s0145.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven succeeded, reverent, bright, and sage, he chose the worthy and employed the able, ministers were harmonious; he bound you with a wall city's weight and honored you with enfeoffment splitting the soil.

s0146.literal: Is it not great design of the temple altars, pushing the red heart upon things?
s0146.idiomatic: Is it not great temple design, pushing the red heart upon things?

s0147.literal: Again and again he made clear edicts, sincere and earnest in kindness; lord and minister's division was settled, flesh-and-blood affection was deep.
s0147.idiomatic: Again and again he made clear edicts, sincere and earnest; lord and minister's division was settled, flesh-and-blood affection deep.

s0148.literal: I did not expect the general, deluded by evil persuasion, suddenly to harbor a different plan—therefore Ji grieves with head in pain, weeping until blood follows the tears.
s0148.idiomatic: I did not expect you, deluded by evil persuasion, suddenly to harbor a different plan—therefore I grieve with head in pain, weeping until blood follows tears.

s0149.literal: Editorial footnote marker 9. The plan of ten thousand completeness—your servant privately grieves for the general.
s0149.idiomatic: [9] The plan of ten thousand completeness—your servant privately grieves for you.

s0150.literal: Though Ji's illness invades old age and his words are not worth gathering, in a thousand thoughts one may gain—please let me state my foolish reckoning.
s0150.idiomatic: Though my illness invades old age and my words are not worth gathering, in a thousand thoughts one may gain—please let me state my foolish reckoning.

s0151.literal: I wish the general would slightly curb thunder, grant a moment's delay, so that I may fully speak my reckless blindness and lay bare liver and gall's sincerity—then though the day of death would be the year of life.
s0151.idiomatic: I wish you would slightly curb thunder, grant a moment's delay, so I may fully speak my reckless blindness and lay bare liver and gall—then though the day of death would be the year of life.

s0153.literal: From Heaven's loathing of Liang's virtue, many hardships piled up, the realm split apart, heroes rose one after another beyond counting—each man thought he had gained it.
s0153.idiomatic: From Heaven's loathing of Liang's virtue, hardships piled up, the realm split apart, heroes rose beyond counting—each thought he had gained it.

s0154.literal: Yet to level the barbarian and cut chaos, save the drowning and support the tottering, the four seas gladly pushed forward, the three numina favored the mandate—the one who yielded and sat facing south was the house of Chen.
s0154.idiomatic: Yet to level the barbarian and cut chaos, save the drowning and support the tottering, the four seas pushed forward, the three numina favored the mandate—who yielded and sat facing south was the house of Chen.

s0155.literal: Is it not that the sequence was fixed, Heaven alone bestowed it, the jade disk answered the fortune?
s0155.idiomatic: Is it not that the sequence was fixed, Heaven alone bestowed it, the jade disk answered fortune?

s0156.literal: The matter is very clear—first point.
s0156.idiomatic: The matter is very clear—first point.

s0159.literal: [succeed] the foundation, Editorial footnote marker 11. bright virtue spread far, Heaven's net spread again, Earth's cord was newly tied.
s0159.idiomatic: [succeed] the foundation, [11] bright virtue spread far, Heaven's net spread again, Earth's cord was newly tied.

s0160.literal: As for Wang Lin's strength and Hou Zhen's force—advancing they were enough to shake the central plains and contend for the realm; retreating enough to bend the strong beyond the Yangzi and spread might in a corner.
s0160.idiomatic: As for Wang Lin's strength and Hou Zhen's force—advancing enough to shake the central plains and contend for the realm; retreating enough to bend the strong beyond the Yangzi and spread might in a corner.

s0161.literal: Yet whether ordering a single column of troops or relying on a single scholar's persuasion, Lin then dissolved like ice, threw himself into a foreign land; Zhen then touched horn and bowed forehead, entrusted his fate at the palace gate.
s0161.idiomatic: Yet whether ordering a single column or relying on one scholar's persuasion, Lin dissolved like ice and threw himself into a foreign land; Zhen touched horn, bowed forehead, and entrusted fate at the palace gate.

s0162.literal: This again is Heaven lending its prestige and removing their trouble.
s0162.idiomatic: This again is Heaven lending prestige and removing their trouble.

s0163.literal: The matter is very clear—second point.
s0163.idiomatic: The matter is very clear—second point.

s0164.literal: Now the general, with the weight of a frontier kinsman and the masses of the southeast, exhausts loyalty in serving above and joins strength in diligent service to the king—is not merit higher than Dou Rong's, favor passing Wu Rui's, splitting jade tallies and judging fields, facing south and calling himself solitary?
s0164.idiomatic: Now you, with a frontier kinsman's weight and the southeast's masses, exhaust loyalty serving above and join strength in diligent service to the king—is not merit higher than Dou Rong's, favor passing Wu Rui's, splitting jade tallies and judging fields, facing south and calling yourself solitary?

s0165.literal: The matter is very clear—third point.
s0165.idiomatic: The matter is very clear—third point.

s0166.literal: Moreover the holy court discards flaws and forgets faults, is broad and thick in gaining men; those who reform and renew themselves are all promoted in turn.
s0166.idiomatic: Moreover the holy court discards flaws and forgets faults, is broad in gaining men; those who reform are all promoted in turn.

s0167.literal: As for Yu Xiaoxu, Pan Chuntuo, Li Xiaoqin, Ouyang Yi, and the rest—all were entrusted with inmost heart, employed as talon and tooth; the breast was open and never had the slightest mote.
s0167.idiomatic: As for Yu Xiaoxu, Pan Chuntuo, Li Xiaoqin, Ouyang Yi, and the rest—all were entrusted with inmost heart, employed as talon and tooth; the breast was open without the slightest mote.

s0168.literal: How much more is the general's rising not Zhang Xiu's, his crime unlike Bi Chen's—what worry of peril and extinction, what loss of wealth and honor?
s0168.idiomatic: How much more—your rising is not Zhang Xiu's, your crime unlike Bi Chen's—what worry of peril, what loss of wealth and honor?

s0169.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, fourth point.
s0169.idiomatic: This again—the matter is very clear, fourth point.

s0170.literal: Now Zhou and Qi are neighbors in harmony, beyond the borders without worry; joining troops in one direction is not morning or evening away—it is not the moment of Liu and Xiang contending, nor the momentum of Chu and Zhao joining—how may one sit at ease with high hands folded and sit discussing the Western Earl?
s0170.idiomatic: Now Zhou and Qi are neighbors in harmony, beyond the borders without worry; joining troops in one direction is not morning or evening away—not Liu and Xiang contending, nor Chu and Zhao joining—how may one sit at ease with hands folded and discuss the Western Earl?

s0171.literal: The matter is very clear—fifth point.
s0171.idiomatic: The matter is very clear—fifth point.

s0172.literal: Moreover General Liu glares wolf-like in a corner, repeatedly beaten and broken, fame and substance wasted, courage and spirit decayed.
s0172.idiomatic: Moreover General Liu glares wolf-like in a corner, repeatedly beaten, fame and substance wasted, courage decayed.

s0173.literal: Gao Zan, Xiang Wenzheng, Liu Yu, Huang Ziyu—these several men, the general knows them: rats with two heads, seeing only profit;
s0173.idiomatic: Gao Zan, Xiang Wenzheng, Liu Yu, Huang Ziyu—these several, you know them: rats with two heads, seeing only profit;

s0174.literal: as for the rest of the generals, they may also be seen.
s0174.idiomatic: as for the rest of the generals, they may also be seen.

s0175.literal: Who can don hard armor and grasp sharp edge, drive deep in long march, tie horses and bury wheels, strive without regard for life, and go before the soldiers?
s0175.idiomatic: Who can don hard armor and grasp sharp edge, drive deep in long march, tie horses and bury wheels, strive without regard for life, and go before the soldiers?

s0176.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, sixth point.
s0176.idiomatic: This again—the matter is very clear, sixth point.

s0177.literal: Moreover is the general's strength like Hou Jing's?
s0177.idiomatic: Moreover is your strength like Hou Jing's?

s0178.literal: Are the general's masses like Wang Lin's?
s0178.idiomatic: Are your masses like Wang Lin's?

s0179.literal: The Martial Emperor destroyed Hou Jing before; the present sovereign broke Wang Lin after—this is Heaven's season, no longer human power.
s0179.idiomatic: The Founder destroyed Hou Jing before; the present sovereign broke Wang Lin after—this is Heaven's season, no longer human power.

s0180.literal: Moreover after arms and armor, the people all loathe disorder—who can abandon graves, cast off wife and children, go forth on a plan of ten thousand deaths without regard, and follow the general between white blades?
s0180.idiomatic: Moreover after arms and armor the people loathe disorder—who can abandon graves, cast off wife and children, go forth on ten thousand deaths without regard, and follow you between white blades?

s0181.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, seventh point.
s0181.idiomatic: This again—the matter is very clear, seventh point.

s0182.literal: Looking through former antiquity and taking mirror from past affairs, Ziyang, Jimeng, overturn followed in succession; Yu Shan and
s0182.idiomatic: Looking through antiquity and taking mirror from past affairs, Ziyang, Jimeng, overturn followed in succession; Yu Shan and

s0184.literal: [Right] Canal, Editorial footnote marker 12. peril and extinction followed in turn—Heaven's mandate may be feared, mountains and rivers are hard to rely on.
s0184.idiomatic: [Right] Canal, [12] peril and extinction followed in turn—Heaven's mandate may be feared, mountains and rivers are hard to rely on.

s0185.literal: How much more when the general wishes with the territory of several commanderies to meet the realm's troops, with a feudal lord's resources to resist the Son of Heaven's command—strong and weak, obedience and rebellion, can they be matched?
s0185.idiomatic: How much more when you wish with several commanderies' territory to meet the realm's troops, with a feudal lord's resources to resist the Son of Heaven's command—strong and weak, obedience and rebellion, can they be matched?

s0186.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, eighth point.
s0186.idiomatic: This again—the matter is very clear, eighth point.

s0187.literal: Moreover those not of our kindred—their hearts must differ.
s0187.idiomatic: Moreover those not of our kindred—their hearts must differ.

s0188.literal: If one does not love his kin, how can he reach to things?
s0188.idiomatic: If one does not love his kin, how can he reach to things?

s0189.literal: General Liu himself is bound by the state's rank, his son is still married to a king's daughter—yet he still abandons Heaven's kin and does not look back, turns his back on the bright lord and stands alone—in days of peril and urgency, how can they share worry and disaster and not turn their backs on the general?
s0189.idiomatic: General Liu is bound by the state's rank, his son married to a king's daughter—yet he abandons Heaven's kin, turns his back on the bright lord and stands alone—in days of peril, how can they share worry and not turn their backs on you?

s0190.literal: As for the army old and strength spent, fearing punishment and coveting reward, there must be the schemes of Han and Zhi at Jinyang, the momentum of Zhang and Chen at Jingxing Pass.
s0190.idiomatic: When the army is old and strength spent, fearing punishment and coveting reward, there must be Han and Zhi's schemes at Jinyang, Zhang and Chen's momentum at Jingxing Pass.

s0191.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, ninth point.
s0191.idiomatic: This again—the matter is very clear, ninth point.

s0192.literal: Moreover the northern army fights a myriad li away; its edge cannot be withstood—the general fights on his own ground and many men look behind.
s0192.idiomatic: Moreover the northern army fights a myriad li away; its edge cannot be withstood—you fight on your own ground and many look behind.

s0193.literal: Liang An's heart turns away, Xiu Xu's strength is a single man—the many cannot match the few, generals cannot compare with commanders; the army goes forth without a name, the affair moves without opportunity—raising troops thus, one does not know its profit.
s0193.idiomatic: Liang An's heart turns away, Xiu Xu's strength is a single man—the many cannot match the few, generals cannot compare; the army goes forth without a name, the affair moves without opportunity—raising troops thus, one does not know its profit.

s0194.literal: As for Han's Wu and Chu, Jin's Ying and Yong—linked cities by the tens, long halberds by the million, uprooting the root and blocking the source to plot their own house and state—were there any who succeeded?
s0194.idiomatic: As for Han's Wu and Chu, Jin's Ying and Yong—linked cities by the tens, long halberds by the million, uprooting root and blocking source to plot house and state—were there any who succeeded?

s0195.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, tenth point.
s0195.idiomatic: This again—the matter is very clear, tenth point.

s0196.literal: For the general's reckoning, there is none better than not going far and returning, breaking kinship with the Liu clan, sending Qin Lang and Kuai Lang promptly as hostages, laying down armor and stilling troops, wholly following the edict.
s0196.idiomatic: For your reckoning, none better than not going far and returning, breaking kinship with the Liu clan, sending Qin Lang and Kuai Lang promptly as hostages, laying down armor and stilling troops, wholly following the edict.

s0197.literal: Moreover the court promises the covenant of the iron certificate and declares the white-horse alliance—I will not eat my words and swear it to the altars of state.
s0197.idiomatic: Moreover the court promises the iron certificate covenant and declares the white-horse alliance—I will not eat my words and swear it to the altars of state.

s0198.literal: Ji has heard that the clear-sighted mirror what is not yet formed, the wise do not reckon twice—this is the effect of success and failure; the general must not doubt.
s0198.idiomatic: I have heard that the clear-sighted mirror what is not yet formed, the wise do not reckon twice—this is the effect of success and failure; you must not doubt.

s0199.literal: The fine line of fortune and calamity admits no hair's breadth between.
s0199.idiomatic: The fine line of fortune and calamity admits no hair's breadth between.

s0200.literal: Now frontier screens are still few, the princes young and tender; all who share the clan branch are showered with favor and planting.
s0200.idiomatic: Now frontier screens are still few, princes young and tender; all who share the clan branch are showered with favor.
